purpose: Independently authored and audited English acronym evaluation. Freeze the selected implementation before one-shot inference. No training, no workplace-accuracy guarantee, and no certification of other finding categories. Preserve failed evaluations; do not tune on this set and call it unseen.

The Request Parcel Tracker page uses its full title. The RPT code appears inside each request but names the priority token, not the page.

posts.body: For public services, RAM means Reference Access Matrix. It lists which reader cards can request each restricted collection.
In preservation storage, RAM means Reel Alignment Monitor, the instrument used before rewinding film.
Both groups use RAM in their own workbooks. The combined equipment-and-access inventory has copied the bare acronym into two rows.

cases.rationale: The team sources affirm two distinct local meanings, so neither competing global alias is allowed.
